payload.claim: The token-check in `_package` raises `"CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is unset; the agent cannot authenticate"`, copied verbatim from `_run_cell`'s refusal. `saffron package` runs no agent at all (`package_phase.package` never calls `run_one_cell` or starts a session), and the token here is only read into `package()`'s credential scan (`saffron/phases/package.py:285-286`). The command's own docstring at `saffron/cli.py:2345` and README.md's new usage block both say "No agent runs", so this error text directly contradicts the behaviour the same diff documents.
